text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day Nishino Flower starts training in earnest for her debut in the Twinkle Series!
choice_data_list: (I'll put together a regimen right away!)
(I'll put together a regimen right away!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite my lack of knowledge and experience, she accepted me as her trainer. With her future in my hands, I know what I have to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's work my fingers to the bone—I'll simply overcome my shortcomings with effort. Just as I feel my resolve renewed…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer! Working hard as always, I see!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Today, our journey together finally begins, so I wanted to come and greet you properly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I, Nishino Flower, will put everything I have into this! Let's do our best!
choice_data_list: Excellent! I'll be counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right! And… I know we don't start training until the afternoon, but…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If you haven't had lunch yet, I thought you might be interested in trying this.
choice_data_list: Is that…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yup, I made a bento box!
choice_data_list: And you're giving it to me?
And you're giving it to me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Of course. I made it especially for you… So please accept it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower's bento box includes rolled omelettes, rice balls, a stewed side dish, and a bean salad, all arranged appetizingly.
choice_data_list: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …How does it taste?
choice_data_list: It's delicious!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yay! ♪
choice_data_list: The stewed side dish is very rich in flavor.
The stewed side dish is very rich in flavor.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You mean the butterbur and deep-fried tofu? I prepared them yesterday, so the flavor had time to really soak through! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Please tell me how you prefer your food to be seasoned. I'll do my best to match your tastes next time!
choice_data_list: You're planning to make me lunch again?
You're planning to make me lunch again?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: As long as you don't mind. I love to cook, but more than anything…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It makes me happy to see people smile as they eat the things I made for them.
choice_data_list: I appreciate the kindness!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Nishino Flower and I eat lunch together, we jump right into her training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower zooms down the track. Though small in stature, I get a sense of her innate talent by how hard she runs. Not to mention…
choice_data_list: (She's blisteringly fast!)
(She's blisteringly fast!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…
choice_data_list: Great running out there!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so? Thank you!
choice_data_list: I see why you were accepted here at such a young age.
I see why you were accepted here at such a young age.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-you're praising me too much… I'm still a long way from where I want to be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower was granted early admission to Tracen Academy. That in and of itself is an amazing accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the fact that she skipped a few grades comes with its own set of concerns…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Trainer, Nishino Flower. Sorry to interrupt your training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong, Tazuna?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Can you spare some time once your session is over? The infirmary doctor would like to have a word with you about Nishino Flower's physique.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: As you are aware, Nishino Flower enrolled at Tracen Academy earlier than most students.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: The decision was based on both her impressive talent and the fact that she was determined to be entering her race-ready stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Being "race-ready" refers to an Umamusume's period of physical development. It's during this time that their ability as an athlete grows dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: Simply put, Nishino Flower is already more than capable of competing in races. However…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Compared to the other students, my body still has a lot of growing left to do… Right?

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: Exactly. I believe this was already discussed with you and your parents prior to your enrollment.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: Trainer, her body is already in a state of flux.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: That's why I implore you to factor in her physical state when making decisions on her training and races. I trust you'll do what you believe is best for her.
choice_data_list: I understand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower is the age of an elementary school student. Naturally, she doesn't compare physically to the others starting their racing careers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There may be times in the future where that leaves her at a disadvantage, but for the time being…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But it's fine for me to keep running, right? I'll just have to train hard to make up for any physical differences!

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's a great mindset to have. I'm sure you'll become a splendid Umamusume. Good luck.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'll do my best. I promise!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I know it won't be easy, but I'll find a way to rise above any hardships!
choice_data_list: I'll do my part, too!
I'll do my part, too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to work even harder than you will!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And, um, on that note… I still have plenty of energy left over, so can I do some extra training?
choice_data_list: Let's not overdo it on the first day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I understand. Are you going to take the rest of the day off, too?
choice_data_list: I think I'll do some studying.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Studying?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While there's nothing keeping her from starting her career, Nishino Flower's circumstances are quite special and require extra attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That means I need to continue learning every day so that I'm ready to tackle any unforeseen problems that might pop up. After all…
choice_data_list: I'm still pretty new at this, you see.
I'm still pretty new at this, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: I'll see you tomorrow, then!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes! Have a nice night!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Trainer didn't sound all too confident…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Despite being so small and inexperienced, Trainer told me I'd do fine and agreed to guide me.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (There's got to be a way for me to repay such kindness and help Trainer gain some courage and confidence.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But how do I do that?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter, Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm sorry! I just got a little lost in my thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (This is Grass Wonder. She's kind and has a gentle nature, and she's a fellow member of the groundskeeping committee.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There's no need to apologize. Just let me know if there's anything you don't understand about your duties.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I appreciate that—thank you! I'll go water the flowers now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm? …Wait a minute. This flower bed is empty. But there was moss phlox growing here before.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, it seems there are no plans to grow anything new in that flower bed for now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If you have any ideas for how to use it, please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (A new flower bed… It sure would be pretty if all kinds of flowers were blooming in it.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Hehe! Watching flowers try their hardest to bloom always gives me so much courage.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Ah.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Perhaps if I work really, really hard, then…
